bullet_points: Load returns.csv, factors.csv, true_betas.csv, market_cap.csv, and book_to_market.csv.
Perform a 36-month rolling OLS regression of stock returns on the MKT_RF factor only.
Calculate out-of-sample residuals for months 37–120.
Save the residual panel, aligned with the original data, and the processed characteristic files to a single consolidated file for efficient downstream I/O.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Estimate market betas, compute out-of-sample residuals, and consolidate all input data.

bullet_points: Construct OLS-FMPs for MKT_RF, SMB, HML, and WML.
Calculate cross-sectional correlations between OLS-FMP weights and market-cap/equal-weight benchmarks.
Generate a multi-panel plot showing time-averaged weight distributions for each factor vs. benchmarks.
Print numerical cross-sectional correlations between OLS weights and market-cap weights for each factor.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Construct OLS-FMPs for all four factors and analyze weight alignment.

bullet_points: Select sub-samples of size N in [10, 50] by ranking stocks by true SMB and HML betas.
Construct OLS-FMPs using Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage and Naive (Identity) covariance.
Calculate the "effective number of bets" for each configuration.
Generate a two-panel plot of concentration vs. N for SMB and WML; print concentration values at N=10, 25, 50.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Analyze FMP concentration across varying N using different covariance estimators.

bullet_points: Sort stocks into quintiles based on residuals (for Size and B/M) and prior 12-month cumulative returns (for WML, skipping the most recent month).
Construct long-short portfolios for each characteristic.
Save the resulting time-series of long-short portfolio returns.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Construct long-short portfolios using residual-based and price-based sorting.

bullet_points: Fix random seed; run 1000 simulation replications per (N, T) grid point.
Compute IR for SMB and WML; determine the probability of failing to reject the null hypothesis of zero premium.
Generate a heatmap plot of this probability for SMB and WML; print the threshold N where probability drops below 0.05.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Simulate IR distributions to identify the limit of observability.

bullet_points: Calculate annualized IR for OLS-FMP (Ledoit-Wolf), OLS-FMP (Naive), and NCS portfolios.
Perform variance decomposition (Var(R_projected) / Var(R_noise)) to isolate factor capture.
Generate a multi-panel figure showing IR vs. N for each portfolio type; print variance decomposition ratios at N=10, 25, 50.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Compute annualized IRs and perform variance-based decomposition.

bullet_points: Compute Newey-West standard errors for all portfolio returns.
Use Block Bootstrap (12-month block length, 1000 replications) to generate confidence intervals for the performance gap between OLS-FMP and NCS.
Identify the N threshold where NCS becomes statistically superior; print the threshold and associated p-values.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Validate performance differences using Newey-West errors and Block Bootstrap.

bullet_points: Organize the Results section into subsections corresponding to Steps 1–7.
Interpret IR decay profiles, the "success illusion," and the empirical breadth threshold for factor recovery.
Explicitly reference all generated plots and quote key numerical results from the engineering steps.
